historical_anchor_scope: Approximately 49 hours for the historical 1,999-example Vistral DEV split, used only as a rough 7B generation anchor; it is not a V30 measurement or proof of any cell's runtime.

assumptions.training: The 24 retained local 7B Q3 cells dominate the critical path. The 12 PhoBERT Q3 rows plus 18 Q2 rows are modeled as 30 smaller training-applicable units at approximately 2 hours each. Q1b contributes evaluation only and no optimizer work.
assumptions.generation: The 24 local 7B Q3 cells use the 49-hour historical anchor. Central batching and removal of per-record overhead are modeled as approximately a 1.34x effective improvement, below the theoretical batch ceiling and not measured.
assumptions.storage_throughput: Checkpoint I/O is modeled at a conservative sustained 100-200 MB/s range for approximately 4-5 GB 7B artifacts. Full-file hash and duplicate-copy savings are rounded at campaign level and are not observed timings.
assumptions.batching_efficiency: No perfect linear scaling is assumed; padding, decode, memory pressure, and scheduler overhead consume part of the theoretical gain.
assumptions.scheduler_overlap: Only independent CPU aggregation, I/O finalization, and limited smaller-model work may overlap. Concurrent 7B jobs on one constrained allocation and DEV-dependent overlap are not credited.
assumptions.reuse_resume: No exact V30 source/run receipts exist in the policy-only profile, so REUSE, RESUME, and BLOCKED rows all receive zero saved-time credit.
assumptions.uncertainty: The conservative case keeps the historical 7B anchor near its old behavior, gives no unmeasured reuse credit, and adds campaign-level uncertainty for serialized gates, queueing, and incomplete telemetry.

arithmetic.azure_and_q1b_evaluation_proxy_hours: 4 Azure rows + 22 Q1b consumers, modeled at 2 hours each = 52 hours
arithmetic.conservative_method: 1523 hours is a rounded campaign-level contingency case that does not rely on exact reuse/resume credit or unvalidated concurrency.

largest_remaining_bottleneck: The 24 retained local 7B Q3 cells, anchored by the historical approximately 49-hour Vistral DEV split, dominate wall-clock time.
limitations: No real-model benchmark or profiling campaign was run.
No live Azure request was made.
The central savings are conditional engineering estimates, not measured speedups.
The estimate must be recalculated if authorized throughput or queue telemetry changes.

report_binding.exact_source_head_semantics: The implementation head validated by the exact-head CI and independent Sentinel; this closure update is report-only.
